literature.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 仅有一种人类分离株A/NV/10/2025被发现能够在雪貂之间高效传播。其他毒株,包括致命猫分离株,均未表现出高效的传播能力。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2751725]
系统发育分析表明,这些H5N1和H5N6分离株是流行于欧亚大陆的HA亚型2.3.4.4b毒株,并且在关键蛋白中缺乏已知的哺乳动物适应性标记。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2746274]
综述得出结论,高致病性禽流感H5N1病毒通过外部拭子在四只鲸类中被检测到,而通过内部器官在一只鲸类中被检测到,这表明该病毒可能与鲸类搁浅事件有关。然而,由于尸检数据有限,病毒在鲸类中的致病作用仍不明确。 [10.3389/fvets.2026.1969182]
存活的白鹤在不同栖息地中被可靠检测,其在拼接觅食区图像中的AP@50达到0.89,在原始觅食区图像中的AP@50达到0.98。死亡的白鹤在水体中被准确检测(AP@50≈0.90),但在陆地觅食区的检测仍较为有限(AP@50≈0.64–0.70),这是基于空中标注而没有现场确认的结果。 [10.1016/j.scitotenv.2026.182358]
在hAEC ALI培养中敲除MX1对适应人类的H1N1pdm09菌株的复制仅有轻微影响,但显著削弱了对人兽共患病牛源H5N1/Texas和禽源H7N9/Anhui菌株的干扰素λ介导的限制作用,导致病毒滴度比MX1功能正常的培养高3-4个对数TCID50。 [10.64898/2026.10.19.759965]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Only one human isolate, A/NV/10/2025, was found to transmit efficiently between ferrets. The other strains, including the lethal cat isolate, did not demonstrate efficient transmission. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2751725]

Phylogenetic analysis indicated that these H5N1 and H5N6 isolates were clade 2.3.4.4b strains circulating within Eurasia and lacked known mammalian adaptation markers in key proteins. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2746274]

The review concludes that HPAIV H5N1 was detected in four cetaceans through external swabs and one through internal organs, suggesting a possible link between the virus and cetacean strandings. However, the pathogenic role of the virus in cetaceans remains inconclusive due to limited necropsy data. [10.3389/fvets.2026.1969182]
Living cranes were detected reliably across habitats, with AP@50 reaching 0.89 in mosaicked feeding-area imagery and 0.98 in raw feeding-area imagery. [10.1016/j.scitotenv.2026.182358]

MX1 knockout in hAEC ALI cultures had only a minor effect on the replication of the human-adapted H1N1pdm09 strain, but markedly impaired interferon lambda-mediated restriction of zoonotic bovine H5N1/Texas and avian H7N9/Anhui strains, leading to viral titers up to 3-4 logs TCID50 higher than in MX1-competent cultures. [10.64898/2026.10.19.759965]

news.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 2026年10月15日,美国华盛顿州雅基马县报告了一例禽流感 A(H5N1)确诊病例,该病例与职业性接触感染奶牛有关。自2024年4月1日起,已报告72例人类病例,包括一例死亡,且未发现持续的人际传播传播。 [news-511155724918ac76]
H5N1 禽流感 在万达尔动物园的水鸟中被确认,由博帕尔的国家高安全动物疾病研究所(NIHSAD)报告。 [news-7b7f1c3d988db380]
一项横断面血清学监测研究发现,2018年至2025年间鄱阳湖周边接触禽类人群对七种禽流感病毒亚型表现出不同的抗体反应。研究结果描述的是抗体反应,而非临床诊断的感染。 [news-d10551761b6c158a]
Vandalur动物园在检测到H5N1禽流感后关闭了两天,如LiveChennai所报道。 [news-7d33ae29881de787]
据WEAU报道,威斯康星州巴伦县商业家禽群中又一禽流感病例得到确认。 [news-fc6298b8ab2be768]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses news
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Avian influenza A viruses news developments.
key_findings_en: A confirmed human case of avian influenza A(H5N1) was reported in Yakima County, Washington, following occupational exposure to infected dairy cattle. Since 1 April 2024, 72 human cases have been reported, including one death, with no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission. [news-511155724918ac76]
H5N1 avian influenza was confirmed in water birds at Vandalur Zoo, reported by the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal. [news-7b7f1c3d988db380]

A cross-sectional serological surveillance study found varied antibody reactivity to seven avian influenza virus subtypes among poultry-exposed people around Poyang Lake between 2018 and 2025. The results describe antibody reactivity, not clinically diagnosed infections. [news-d10551761b6c158a]
The zoo was closed for two days after H5N1 bird flu was detected, as reported by LiveChennai. [news-7d33ae29881de787]

papers.title: Highly pathogenic avian influenza virus H5N1 infection in stranded porpoises and dolphins in Chile
papers.abstract: Between 2022 and 2023, a significant increase in mortality among marine birds and pinnipeds along the Pacific coasts of Peru and Chile was linked to the highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV H5N1). In response, the Chilean Fisheries and Aquaculture Service (SERNAPESCA) initiated a survey to document cetacean strandings and assess the presence of HPAIV H5N1 via molecular analysis of swab samples. In 2023, 205 cetacean stranding events involving 281 individuals were recorded. Of the 27 sampled animals, four, comprising two Burmeister’s porpoises ( Phocoena spinipinnis ) and two Chilean dolphins ( Cephalorhynchus eutropia ) from different locations, tested positive for HPAIV H5N1 in spiracle, rectal and genital swabs. Additionally, a necropsy performed on a long-beaked common dolphin ( Delphinus delphis ), which had tested negative on swabs, revealed the presence of HPAIV H5N1 through PCR analysis of lung and brain tissues. Histopathological examination showed mild, multifocal lymphoplasmacytic-histiocytic and suppurative leptomeningitis, consistent with lesions associated with HPAIV H5N1 infection, although immunohistochemistry was negative. While the virus’s pathogenic role in cetaceans remains inconclusive due to the limited number of necropsies performed, the detection of HPAIV H5N1 in five cetaceans (two porpoises and three dolphins), Four through external swabs —and one dolphin through internal organs—alongside with elevated mortality in birds and pinnipeds, suggests a potential association between cetacean strandings and HPAIV H5N1 outbreaks. This epidemiological finding warrants further investigation.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study investigates the potential association between HPAIV H5N1 outbreaks and increased cetacean strandings in Chile, focusing on the role of avian influenza A viruses in marine mammals. The central question is whether HPAIV H5N1 is involved in the observed mortality and stranding events among marine birds and pinnipeds.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a survey initiated by the Chilean Fisheries and Aquaculture Service (SERNAPESCA) to document cetacean strandings and assess the presence of HPAIV H5N1 via molecular analysis of swab samples. The evidence includes data on stranding events, molecular testing results, and necropsy findings.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that HPAIV H5N1 was detected in four cetaceans through external swabs and one through internal organs, suggesting a possible link between the virus and cetacean strandings. However, the pathogenic role of the virus in cetaceans remains inconclusive due to limited necropsy data.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the pathogenic role of HPAIV H5N1 in cetaceans is not definitively established, as only a limited number of necropsies were performed. Additionally, the association between cetacean strandings and HPAIV H5N1 outbreaks is not fully confirmed, highlighting the need for more comprehensive studies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest the need for further investigation into the role of HPAIV H5N1 in cetacean strandings and mortality. This includes expanding necropsy efforts, enhancing surveillance, and exploring the mechanisms of viral transmission to marine mammals.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential link between HPAIV H5N1 outbreaks and increased cetacean strandings in Chile. Between 2022 and 2023, a notable rise in marine bird and pinniped mortality was observed, prompting a survey by SERNAPESCA to assess HPAIV H5N1 presence in cetaceans. In 2023, 205 stranding events involving 281 individuals were recorded, with four cetaceans testing positive for HPAIV H5N1 through swabs and one through necropsy. Histopathological findings were consistent with HPAIV H5N1 infection, though immunohistochemistry was negative. The review highlights the inconclusive role of the virus in cetacean mortality and calls for further research to clarify its impact and transmission mechanisms.

papers.title_zh: 高致病性禽流感病毒H5N1感染在智利搁浅的海豚和鲸类中的发现
papers.source_body_en: Between 2022 and 2023, a significant increase in mortality among marine birds and pinnipeds along the Pacific coasts of Peru and Chile was linked to the highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV H5N1). In response, the Chilean Fisheries and Aquaculture Service (SERNAPESCA) initiated a survey to document cetacean strandings and assess the presence of HPAIV H5N1 via molecular analysis of swab samples. In 2023, 205 cetacean stranding events involving 281 individuals were recorded. Of the 27 sampled animals, four, comprising two Burmeister’s porpoises ( Phocoena spinipinnis ) and two Chilean dolphins ( Cephalorhynchus eutropia ) from different locations, tested positive for HPAIV H5N1 in spiracle, rectal and genital swabs. Additionally, a necropsy performed on a long-beaked common dolphin ( Delphinus delphis ), which had tested negative on swabs, revealed the presence of HPAIV H5N1 through PCR analysis of lung and brain tissues. Histopathological examination showed mild, multifocal lymphoplasmacytic-histiocytic and suppurative leptomeningitis, consistent with lesions associated with HPAIV H5N1 infection, although immunohistochemistry was negative. While the virus’s pathogenic role in cetaceans remains inconclusive due to the limited number of necropsies performed, the detection of HPAIV H5N1 in five cetaceans (two porpoises and three dolphins), Four through external swabs —and one dolphin through internal organs—alongside with elevated mortality in birds and pinnipeds, suggests a potential association between cetacean strandings and HPAIV H5N1 outbreaks. This epidemiological finding warrants further investigation.

papers.title: Variable transmission efficiency of mammalian origin HPAI D1.1 H5N1 strains in ferrets
papers.abstract: AbstractHighly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 2.3.4.4b genotype D1.1 lineage continues to predominate in the United States wild bird population and has spilled over into dairy cattle three independent times. To assess the transmission risk of this sublineage, we performed direct-contact transmission experiments for three distinct D1.1 strains in ferrets. Two of these strains were isolated from humans and one from a lethal cat infection. We found that only one human isolate (A/NV/10/2025) was able to transmit efficiently between ferrets. Compared to the other strains, this isolate harbored the mammalian adaptive PB2 D701N mutation, suggesting this mutation may be a candidate contributing to enhanced transmission efficiency of D1.1 as opposed to the PB2 E627 K substitution present in the lethal cat isolate. Based on these data we conclude that the transmission fitness of D1.1 strains is modest but special attention should be paid to emergence of adaptation at the PB2 701 position.

The research sought to understand the potential zoonotic risk and transmission dynamics of these strains.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved direct-contact transmission experiments conducted with three distinct D1.1 H5N1 strains in ferrets. Two of the strains were isolated from human infections, while the third was obtained from a lethal cat infection.
analysis.methods: Transmission experiments were performed using direct contact between ferrets to assess the ability of the D1.1 H5N1 strains to spread. The strains were tested in a controlled setting to determine their transmission fitness.
analysis.main_results: Only one human isolate, A/NV/10/2025, was found to transmit efficiently between ferrets. The other strains, including the lethal cat isolate, did not demonstrate efficient transmission.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the mammalian adaptive PB2 D701N mutation may enhance transmission efficiency in D1.1 H5N1 strains, distinguishing them from the PB2 E627K substitution present in the cat isolate.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the importance of monitoring specific mutations in HPAI D1.1 strains for their potential to increase transmission efficiency, which has implications for zoonotic surveillance and risk assessment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to ferret models and does not account for other potential hosts or environmental factors. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on controlled experimental conditions rather than real-world data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the transmission efficiency of mammalian-origin HPAI D1.1 H5N1 strains in ferrets, as these strains have been increasingly detected in wild bird populations and have spilled over into dairy cattle. The research aimed to understand the potential zoonotic risk and transmission dynamics of these strains. Three distinct D1.1 H5N1 strains were tested in direct-contact transmission experiments, with two isolated from human infections and one from a lethal cat infection. Only one human isolate, A/NV/10/2025, was found to transmit efficiently between ferrets, while the others did not. The isolate that transmitted efficiently harbored the mammalian adaptive PB2 D701N mutation, suggesting this mutation may contribute to enhanced transmission efficiency in D1.1 strains compared to the PB2 E627K substitution in the cat isolate. The study concludes that the transmission fitness of D1.1 strains is modest, but the emergence of specific mutations at the PB2 701 position warrants special attention. The findings have implications for zoonotic surveillance and risk assessment, emphasizing the need to monitor mutations that may enhance transmission. However, the study is limited to ferret models and does not account for other hosts or environmental factors, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

papers.title_zh: 哺乳动物来源的高致病性禽流感D1.1系H5N1毒株在雪貂中的传播效率差异
papers.source_body_en: AbstractHighly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 2.3.4.4b genotype D1.1 lineage continues to predominate in the United States wild bird population and has spilled over into dairy cattle three independent times. To assess the transmission risk of this sublineage, we performed direct-contact transmission experiments for three distinct D1.1 strains in ferrets. Two of these strains were isolated from humans and one from a lethal cat infection. We found that only one human isolate (A/NV/10/2025) was able to transmit efficiently between ferrets. Compared to the other strains, this isolate harbored the mammalian adaptive PB2 D701N mutation, suggesting this mutation may be a candidate contributing to enhanced transmission efficiency of D1.1 as opposed to the PB2 E627 K substitution present in the lethal cat isolate. Based on these data we conclude that the transmission fitness of D1.1 strains is modest but special attention should be paid to emergence of adaptation at the PB2 701 position.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:高致病性禽流感D1.1系H5N1毒株2.3.4.4b基因型在美国持续占据主导地位,并已跨物种溢出至奶牛中三次。为了评估该亚系的传播风险,我们在雪貂中进行了直接接触实验,测试了三种不同的D1.1毒株。其中两种毒株是从人类感染中分离的,另一种是从致命的猫感染中获得的。我们发现,仅有一种人类分离株(A/NV/10/2025)能够在雪貂之间高效传播。与其他毒株相比,该分离株携带了哺乳动物适应性PB2 D701N突变,这表明该突变可能是导致D1.1系传播效率增强的候选因素,而不是致命猫分离株中所含的PB2 E627K替代突变。基于这些数据,我们得出结论:D1.1系毒株的传播效率相对较低,但应特别关注PB2 701位点的适应性突变的出现。

papers.title: Co-circulation of H5N1 and H5N6 High Pathogenicity Avian Influenza Viruses in Migratory Birds at a Coastal Wintering Site in China
papers.abstract: Since 2020, H5Nx high Pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) belonging to hemagglutinin (HA) clade 2.3.4.4b have undergone widespread dispersal in wild birds, posing substantial threats to global poultry populations and mammals worldwide. In this study, we report the co-circulation of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 and H5N6 HPAIVs associated with mortality events in Anseriformes and Charadriiformes at a coastal wintering site in Fujian Province, China. H5N1 and H5N6 viruses were identified in 4 species of waterfowl (Bean Goose, Eastern Spot-billed Duck, Eurasian Wigeon, and Eurasian Curlew). Phylogenetic analysis indicated that these H5N1 and H5N6 isolates were clade 2.3.4.4b strains circulating within Eurasia and lacked known mammalian adaptation markers in key proteins. The infected birds exhibited severe systemic multi-organ pathology, with the most pronounced damage observed in the lungs. H5N6 and H5N1 viruses caused lethal injury in BALB/c mice, with H5N1 leading to systemic infection. Environmental sampling also revealed the presence of H5N1 HPAIVs alongside low-pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs) such as H3N1 and H6N1. Our findings highlight the complex and dynamic transmission patterns of H5 HPAIV in wild bird populations and the substantial threat they pose to mammals, underscoring the critical importance of sustained surveillance for high pathogenicity avian influenza in wild birds.

papers.abstract_zh: 自2020年以来,属于血凝素(HA)亚型2.3.4.4b的H5Nx高致病性禽流感病毒(HPAIVs)在野生鸟类中广泛传播,对全球家禽种群和世界各地的哺乳动物构成重大威胁。本研究报告了在中国福建省沿海越冬地,雁形目和鸻形目鸟类中与死亡率事件相关的HA亚型2.3.4.4b H5N1和H5N6 HPAIVs的共循环现象。H5N1和H5N6病毒在4种水禽(豆雁、东斑鸭、欧斑鸭和欧文鸟)中被鉴定出来。系统发育分析表明,这些H5N1和H5N6分离株是流行于欧亚大陆的HA亚型2.3.4.4b毒株,并且在关键蛋白中缺乏已知的哺乳动物适应性标记。感染的鸟类表现出严重的全身多器官病理变化,其中肺部损伤最为显著。H5N6和H5N1病毒在BALB/c小鼠中导致致命性损伤,其中H5N1病毒引发全身感染。环境采样还显示H5N1 HPAIVs与低致病性禽流感病毒(LPAIVs)如H3N1和H6N1共存。我们的研究结果突显了H5 HPAIV在野生鸟类种群中复杂的动态传播模式,并强调了其对哺乳动物构成的重大威胁,凸显了对高致病性禽流感病毒在野生鸟类中进行持续监测的重要性。

papers.title: Mammalian H5N1 cases predict online discourse volume and emotion during the 2024–2025 H5N1 outbreak
papers.abstract: Abstract The surge of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) infection in animals across the United States since 2024 has renewed pandemic concern, making public perception a critical determinant of effective risk communication. We analyzed 42,957 Reddit comments (January 2024–December 2025) to characterize the patterns in online discourse during the outbreak. Topic modeling identified themes of public health, pandemic comparisons, and food safety. Sentiment analysis identified fear as the dominant emotional response, while anger was the most event-reactive, correlating with reported cases in cats, poultry, and wild mammals. Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (ARIMAX) models with blocked cross-validation identified reported cases in domestic cats and dairy cattle as predictors of weekly Reddit engagement, reducing forecasting error by 31% over baseline. Mammalian cases thus were associated with early-warning signals for public reaction during the 2024–2025 outbreak, offering a one-week window for proactive risk communication.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how public perception of H5N1 outbreaks influenced risk communication, as the surge of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) infection in animals across the United States since 2024 has renewed pandemic concern.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 42,957 Reddit comments from January 2024 to December 2025 to characterize online discourse patterns during the H5N1 outbreak.
analysis.methods: Topic modeling was used to identify themes in the online discourse, while sentiment analysis was conducted to determine emotional responses. ARIMAX models with blocked cross-validation were employed to forecast weekly Reddit engagement based on reported cases.
analysis.main_results: Sentiment analysis revealed fear as the dominant emotional response, with anger being the most event-reactive. Reported cases in cats, poultry, and wild mammals correlated with anger. ARIMAX models identified domestic cat and dairy cattle cases as predictors of weekly Reddit engagement, reducing forecasting error by 31% over baseline.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that mammalian cases of H5N1 are associated with early-warning signals for public reaction, providing a one-week window for proactive risk communication.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results offer insights into using online discourse as a tool for monitoring public reaction to H5N1 outbreaks, which can inform more effective risk communication strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on online data, which may not fully represent public sentiment. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the use of a single data source and potential biases in social media engagement.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the relationship between mammalian H5N1 cases and public perception during the 2024–2025 outbreak. By analyzing 42,957 Reddit comments, the researchers identified fear as the dominant emotional response and anger as the most event-reactive. They found that reported cases in cats, poultry, and wild mammals correlated with anger, while ARIMAX models with blocked cross-validation showed that domestic cat and dairy cattle cases predicted weekly Reddit engagement, reducing forecasting error by 31%. The study suggests that mammalian cases can serve as early-warning signals for public reaction, offering a one-week window for proactive risk communication. However, the reliance on online data introduces potential biases, limiting the strength of the evidence. The findings have implications for monitoring public sentiment and improving risk communication strategies during H5N1 outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解H5N1 暴发公众认知如何影响风险沟通,因为自2024年以来,美国各地动物中高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)感染的激增重新引发了对大流行的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了2024年1月至2025年12月期间的42,957条Reddit评论,以描述H5N1 暴发期间的在线讨论模式。
elements_zh.methods: 使用主题建模来识别在线讨论中的主题,同时进行情感分析以确定情绪反应。采用带有阻塞交叉验证的自回归积分移动平均模型(ARIMAX)来基于报告的病例预测每周Reddit参与度。
elements_zh.main_results: 情感分析显示恐惧是主导的情绪反应,愤怒则是最具事件反应性的。报告的猫、家禽和野生哺乳动物病例与愤怒相关。ARIMAX模型识别出家猫和乳牛病例是预测每周Reddit参与度的指标,相较于基线,预测误差减少了31%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,H5N1在哺乳动物中的病例与公众反应的早期预警信号相关,为积极的风险沟通提供了为期一周的窗口。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how public perception of H5N1 outbreaks influenced risk communication, as the surge of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) infection in animals across the United States since 2024 has renewed pandemic concern.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 42,957 Reddit comments from January 2024 to December 2025 to characterize online discourse patterns during the H5N1 outbreak.
analysis_en.methods: Topic modeling was used to identify themes in the online discourse, while sentiment analysis was conducted to determine emotional responses. ARIMAX models with blocked cross-validation were employed to forecast weekly Reddit engagement based on reported cases.
analysis_en.main_results: Sentiment analysis revealed fear as the dominant emotional response, with anger being the most event-reactive. Reported cases in cats, poultry, and wild mammals correlated with anger. ARIMAX models identified domestic cat and dairy cattle cases as predictors of weekly Reddit engagement, reducing forecasting error by 31% over baseline.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that mammalian cases of H5N1 are associated with early-warning signals for public reaction, providing a one-week window for proactive risk communication.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results offer insights into using online discourse as a tool for monitoring public reaction to H5N1 outbreaks, which can inform more effective risk communication strategies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on online data, which may not fully represent public sentiment. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the use of a single data source and potential biases in social media engagement.

papers.title_zh: 哺乳动物H5N1病例预测2024–2025年H5N1 暴发期间在线讨论量和情绪
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The surge of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) infection in animals across the United States since 2024 has renewed pandemic concern, making public perception a critical determinant of effective risk communication. We analyzed 42,957 Reddit comments (January 2024–December 2025) to characterize the patterns in online discourse during the outbreak. Topic modeling identified themes of public health, pandemic comparisons, and food safety. Sentiment analysis identified fear as the dominant emotional response, while anger was the most event-reactive, correlating with reported cases in cats, poultry, and wild mammals. Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Regressors (ARIMAX) models with blocked cross-validation identified reported cases in domestic cats and dairy cattle as predictors of weekly Reddit engagement, reducing forecasting error by 31% over baseline. Mammalian cases thus were associated with early-warning signals for public reaction during the 2024–2025 outbreak, offering a one-week window for proactive risk communication.

papers.title: Genetic modification of primary airway epithelial cell cultures defines MX1 as a barrier for zoonotic influenza A viruses in the human respiratory epithelium
papers.abstract: The antiviral innate immune response is a major species barrier that emerging viruses must overcome to infect and transmit efficiently in new hosts. In humans, the interferon-stimulated MX1 gene encodes the antiviral MX1 protein, which restricts zoonotic influenza A viruses (IAVs). Resistance to MX1 is considered a key feature of human-adapted IAVs and a potential determinant of zoonotic and pandemic risk. However, MX1-mediated restriction and viral escape have mostly been investigated in cell lines and animal models, which incompletely recapitulate virus-host interactions in the human airway epithelium, representing the primary site of IAV replication. Although primary human airway epithelial cell (hAEC) cultures, such as airway organoids and air-liquid interface (ALI) cultures, provide a physiologically relevant model, their use in studying MX1 restriction has been limited by challenges in achieving efficient and reliable genetic modification. Here, we used engineered virus-like particles (eVLPs) to deliver Cas9-sgRNA ribonucleoprotein complexes into primary hAECs and disrupt MX1 expression. This approach generated MX1-knockout airway organoids and organoid-derived hAEC ALI cultures with >90% genomic-level editing efficiency and near-complete loss of MX1 protein, while preserving epithelial differentiation at the air-liquid interface. MX1 knockout in hAEC ALI cultures had only a minor effect on the replication kinetics of the human-adapted H1N1pdm09 strain. By contrast, MX1 knockout markedly impaired interferon lambda-mediated restriction of the zoonotic bovine H5N1/Texas and avian H7N9/Anhui strains, resulting in viral titers up to 3-4 logs TCID50 higher than in MX1-competent cultures. These findings provide direct evidence that MX1 restricts zoonotic IAVs in primary human airway epithelium. Our study establishes a biologically relevant platform for assessing the sensitivity of emerging IAVs to a key antiviral host factor and thereby informs evaluations into their zoonotic and pandemic risk.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of the MX1 gene in restricting zoonotic influenza A viruses in the human respiratory epithelium. Using primary human airway epithelial cell cultures, the researchers disrupted MX1 expression through engineered virus-like particles (eVLPs) delivering Cas9-sgRNA complexes. They found that MX1 knockout had minimal impact on the replication of the human-adapted H1N1pdm09 strain but significantly impaired interferon lambda-mediated restriction of zoonotic bovine H5N1/Texas and avian H7N9/Anhui strains, resulting in higher viral titers. These results provide direct evidence that MX1 acts as a barrier for zoonotic IAVs in human airway epithelium, offering a biologically relevant model for assessing pandemic risk. The study's findings are supported by high genomic-level editing efficiency but are limited by the challenges of genetic modification in primary hAECs, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

papers.abstract_zh: 先天性抗病毒屏障抗病毒药物是新兴病毒必须克服的主要物种屏障,以在新的宿主宿主中有效感染和传播。在人类中,干扰素刺激的MX1基因编码抗病毒屏障MX1蛋白,该蛋白限制了人兽共患病流感A病毒(IAVs)。对MX1的抗性被认为是适应人类的IAVs的关键特征,也是人兽共患病和大流行风险的潜在决定因素。然而,MX1介导的限制和病毒逃逸机制大多是在细胞系和动物模型中研究的,这些模型无法完全再现病毒与人类气道上皮细胞的相互作用,而人类气道上皮细胞是IAVs复制的主要部位。尽管原代人类气道上皮细胞(hAEC)培养,如气道类器官和气液界面(ALI)培养,提供了生理相关的模型,但其在研究MX1限制作用方面受到实现高效且可靠基因改造的挑战的限制。在这里,我们使用工程化的病毒样颗粒(eVLPs)将Cas9-sgRNA核糖核蛋白复合物递送至原代hAEC中,以破坏MX1的表达。这种方法产生了具有>90%基因组水平编辑效率且几乎完全丧失MX1蛋白的MX1敲除气道类器官和类器官衍生的hAEC ALI培养。在hAEC ALI培养中敲除MX1对适应人类的H1N1pdm09菌株的复制动力学仅有轻微影响,但对人兽共患病牛源H5N1/Texas和禽源H7N9/Anhui菌株的干扰素λ介导的限制作用则显著削弱,导致病毒滴度比MX1功能正常的培养高3-4个对数TCID50。这些发现直接证明了MX1在原代人类气道上皮中限制人兽共患病IAVs的作用。本研究建立了一个生物相关平台,用于评估新兴IAVs对关键宿主因素宿主的敏感性,从而为评估其人兽共患病和大流行风险提供了信息。

papers.title: Rapid UAV-based detection of crane (Grus grus) mortality hotspots during an H5N1 avian influenza outbreak using deep learning
papers.abstract: Rapid detection of wildlife mortality during infectious disease outbreaks is essential for ecological risk mitigation, zoonotic-risk management, and timely intervention, yet field surveys are often slow, labor-intensive, and spatially limited. This study evaluates unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery combined with deep learning as an operational surveillance tool for mapping live and deceased Common Cranes ( Grus grus ) during a highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) outbreak in the Hula Valley, Israel. High-resolution RGB imagery was collected over aquatic roosting and terrestrial feeding habitats and annotated to distinguish living and dead individuals. A YOLOv8-based detection framework was tested using habitat-specific training, combined multi-habitat training, and transfer learning from a large avian dataset, together with selective data augmentation, sliding-window inference, and Weighted Boxes Fusion. Living cranes were detected reliably across habitats, with AP@50 reaching 0.89 in mosaicked feeding-area imagery and 0.98 in raw feeding-area imagery. Dead cranes were detected accurately in water bodies (AP@50 ≈ 0.90), but detection in terrestrial feeding areas remained more limited (AP@50 ≈ 0.64–0.70), based on aerial annotations without in situ confirmation. Oversampling, undersampling, and focal loss provided limited improvement, suggesting that class imbalance alone does not fully explain the lower terrestrial detection performance, and that carcass scarcity, limited visual diversity, and ambiguity against heterogeneous ground backgrounds may also contribute. Joint multi-habitat training and transfer learning improved generalization for the rare dead-crane class on land. These findings demonstrate the value of UAV-based deep learning for rapid mortality assessment and hotspot identification during wildlife disease outbreaks.

A YOLOv8-based detection framework was tested using habitat-specific training, combined multi-habitat training, and transfer learning from a large avian dataset, together with selective data augmentation, sliding-window inference, and Weighted Boxes Fusion. Living cranes were detected reliably across habitats, with AP@50 reaching 0.89 in mosaicked feeding-area imagery and 0.98 in raw feeding-area imagery. Dead cranes were detected accurately in water bodies (AP@50 ≈ 0.90), but detection in terrestrial feeding areas remained more limited (AP@50 ≈ 0.64–0.70), based on aerial annotations without in situ confirmation. Oversampling, undersampling, and focal loss provided limited improvement, suggesting that class imbalance alone does not fully explain the lower terrestrial detection performance, and that carcass scarcity, limited visual diversity, and ambiguity against heterogeneous ground backgrounds may also contribute. Joint multi-habitat training and transfer learning improved generalization for the rare dead-crane class on land. These findings demonstrate the value of UAV-based deep learning for rapid mortality assessment and hotspot identification during wildlife disease outbreaks.

papers.title: Highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza infection and exposure in waterfowl and waterbirds of the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex, 2022-2025
papers.abstract: The introduction of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 into North America in 2021 marked a significant shift in disease dynamics for wild waterfowl populations. To assess infection and seroprevalence trends following this incursion, we leveraged ongoing capture efforts at the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex between October 2022 and July 2025 to conduct sampling for HPAI H5N1 prevalence and seroprevalence. Our efforts resulted in the analysis of 384 swab and 204 sera samples from assorted waterfowl and waterbird species. HPAI H5N1 infection was confirmed in only three individuals (two Snow Geese and one Greater White-fronted Goose), all asymptomatic at capture. Antibodies to influenza A viruses (IAVs) were detected in all duck and goose species with the majority of positive samples also testing positive for antibodies to both H5 and N1, demonstrating a relatively high population level of previous exposure and likely immunity that aligns with previous findings in these species. This study also reports the first known observation of H5 antibodies in American Coot, though both overall IAV seroprevalence and H5 specific antibodies were notably lower than in sympatric waterfowl. This disparity suggests that American Coot may have lower susceptibility to infection or exhibit behavior that limits exposure compared to sympatric waterfowl. Together these results underscore the value of serologic surveillance as a supportive surveillance strategy to better inform potential management strategies related to HPAI H5N1 risk in wild birds.
papers.journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology

Researchers collected 384 swab and 204 serum specimens from assorted waterfowl and waterbird species, confirming HPAI H5N1 infection in three asymptomatic individuals (two Snow Geese and one Greater White‐fronted Goose) and detecting influenza A virus antibodies in all duck and goose species, with most positives also positive for H5 and N1 antibodies, indicating high prior exposure. papers.title_zh: 高度致病性H5N1 禽流感感染及在萨克拉门托国家野生动物保护区复合体中的水禽和水鸟暴露情况,2022-2025年
papers.source_body_en: The introduction of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 into North America in 2021 marked a significant shift in disease dynamics for wild waterfowl populations. To assess infection and seroprevalence trends following this incursion, we leveraged ongoing capture efforts at the Sacramento National Wildlife Refuge Complex between October 2022 and July 2025 to conduct sampling for HPAI H5N1 prevalence and seroprevalence. Our efforts resulted in the analysis of 384 swab and 204 sera samples from assorted waterfowl and waterbird species. HPAI H5N1 infection was confirmed in only three individuals (two Snow Geese and one Greater White-fronted Goose), all asymptomatic at capture. Antibodies to influenza A viruses (IAVs) were detected in all duck and goose species with the majority of positive samples also testing positive for antibodies to both H5 and N1, demonstrating a relatively high population level of previous exposure and likely immunity that aligns with previous findings in these species. This study also reports the first known observation of H5 antibodies in American Coot, though both overall IAV seroprevalence and H5 specific antibodies were notably lower than in sympatric waterfowl. This disparity suggests that American Coot may have lower susceptibility to infection or exhibit behavior that limits exposure compared to sympatric waterfowl. Together these results underscore the value of serologic surveillance as a supportive surveillance strategy to better inform potential management strategies related to HPAI H5N1 risk in wild birds.
papers.abstract_zh: 2021年高致病性禽流感(HPAI)H5N1病毒亚型2.3.4.4b 高致病性禽流感传入北美,标志着野生水禽种群疾病动态的重大转变。为评估此次入侵后感染和血清流行率的趋势,我们利用2022年10月至2025年7月期间在萨克拉门托国家野生动物保护区复合体进行的持续捕捉活动,采集样本以检测HPAI H5N1 患病率和血清流行率。我们的工作共分析了384份拭子样本和204份血清样本,来自多种水禽和水鸟物种。仅在三只个体(两只雪雁和一只大白额雁)中确认了HPAI H5N1感染,且这些个体在捕捉时均无症状。所有鸭类和鹅类物种均检测到流感A病毒(IAVs)抗体,其中大多数阳性样本同时检测到H5和N1抗体,表明这些物种中存在相对较高的既往暴露水平和可能的免疫力,这与之前在这些物种中的发现一致。本研究还首次报告了在美国黑水鸡中检测到H5抗体,尽管其总体IAVs 血清流行率和H5特异性抗体水平明显低于同域水禽。这种差异表明,美国黑水鸡可能对感染的易感性较低,或表现出限制暴露的行为。这些结果共同强调了血清学监测作为支持性监测策略的价值,有助于更好地制定与HPAI H5N1风险相关的管理策略(A1,A2).

papers.title: Rethinking avian influenza control: a systems-oriented One Health perspective for family poultry
papers.abstract: Early detection and control of high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI, LPAI) in family poultry flocks remain challenging in settings where mortality from enzootic diseases such as Newcastle disease (ND) and infectious bursal disease (IBD) is persistently high. High background mortality obscures recognition of unusual disease events and delays reporting. In addition to epidemiological constraints, rebuilding trust among family poultry producers, particularly those affected by uncompensated culling during previous HPAI outbreaks, is essential for effective control. Locally grounded, participatory approaches that recognize the lived experience of both women and men poultry keepers are required to strengthen surveillance, reporting, and response. This policy-oriented rapid review synthesized 110 peer-reviewed publications and 27 policy and guidance documents to examine the structural, epidemiological and socio-economic factors influencing HPAI and LPAI prevention and control in family poultry systems. Effective HPAI and LPAI control should be embedded within a broader, systems-oriented strategy that improves overall poultry productivity and explicitly values smallholder knowledge and participation. A multi-hazard risk management approach grounded in One Health is required, i.e., one that addresses equity, food and nutrition security, livelihoods, climate resilience, and global health. Building on a nine-factor assessment of the factors shaping avian influenza control feasibility, we group practical entry points into three complementary themes: (1) structural constraints within family poultry production systems, including the use of locally adapted poultry genotypes, safe, improved access to safe markets and sustainable feed systems, and effective control of enzootic vaccine-preventable diseases; (2) governance, institutional and social barriers, including culturally appropriate outbreak preparedness and response protocols; (3) gender and socio-economic equity, encompassing participatory approaches grounded in inclusivity, transparency, and accountability. Functional cross-sectoral collaboration between public health, animal health, and environmental sectors, along with local government, is essential if One Health approaches are to deliver tangible, cost-effective reductions in zoonotic risk and effective response while supporting sustainable household food and nutrition security.

papers.title_zh: 重新思考禽流感控制:以家庭家禽为中心的系统导向One Health视角
papers.source_body_en: Early detection and control of high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI, LPAI) in family poultry flocks remain challenging in settings where mortality from enzootic diseases such as Newcastle disease (ND) and infectious bursal disease (IBD) is persistently high. High background mortality obscures recognition of unusual disease events and delays reporting. In addition to epidemiological constraints, rebuilding trust among family poultry producers, particularly those affected by uncompensated culling during previous HPAI outbreaks, is essential for effective control. Locally grounded, participatory approaches that recognize the lived experience of both women and men poultry keepers are required to strengthen surveillance, reporting, and response. This policy-oriented rapid review synthesized 110 peer-reviewed publications and 27 policy and guidance documents to examine the structural, epidemiological and socio-economic factors influencing HPAI and LPAI prevention and control in family poultry systems. Effective HPAI and LPAI control should be embedded within a broader, systems-oriented strategy that improves overall poultry productivity and explicitly values smallholder knowledge and participation. A multi-hazard risk management approach grounded in One Health is required, i.e., one that addresses equity, food and nutrition security, livelihoods, climate resilience, and global health. Building on a nine-factor assessment of the factors shaping avian influenza control feasibility, we group practical entry points into three complementary themes: (1) structural constraints within family poultry production systems, including the use of locally adapted poultry genotypes, safe, improved access to safe markets and sustainable feed systems, and effective control of enzootic vaccine-preventable diseases; (2) governance, institutional and social barriers, including culturally appropriate outbreak preparedness and response protocols; (3) gender and socio-economic equity, encompassing participatory approaches grounded in inclusivity, transparency, and accountability. Functional cross-sectoral collaboration between public health, animal health, and environmental sectors, along with local government, is essential if One Health approaches are to deliver tangible, cost-effective reductions in zoonotic risk and effective response while supporting sustainable household food and nutrition security.
papers.abstract_zh: 在家庭家禽群中,早期检测和控制高致病性和低致病性禽流感(HPAI,LPAI)仍然具有挑战性,尤其是在新城疫(ND)和传染性法氏囊病(IBD)等地方性疾病的死亡率水平持续较高的情况下。高背景死亡率会掩盖异常疾病事件的识别并延迟报告。除了流行病学限制外,重建家庭家禽生产者之间的信任,特别是那些在之前HPAI 暴发中遭受无补偿扑杀影响的生产者,对于有效的控制至关重要。需要基于本地实际情况、参与式的方法,以承认男女家禽饲养者的实际经验,从而加强监测、报告和响应。这项政策导向的快速综述综合了110篇同行评审的文献和27份政策与指导文件,以探讨影响家庭家禽系统中HPAI和LPAI预防与控制的结构性、流行病学和社会经济因素。有效的HPAI和LPAI控制应嵌入更广泛的系统导向策略中,以提高整体家禽生产力,并明确重视小农户的知识和参与。需要基于One Health的多危害风险管理方法,即一种能够应对公平性、粮食和营养安全、生计、气候韧性以及全球健康问题的方法。在基于九因素评估禽流感控制可行性的基础上,我们将实际切入点归类为三个互补的主题:(1)家庭家禽生产系统中的结构性限制,包括使用本地适应的家禽基因型、安全且改进的市场准入以及可持续的饲料系统,以及有效控制地方性疫苗可预防疾病;(2)治理、制度和社会障碍,包括文化适宜的暴发准备和响应协议;(3)性别与社会经济公平性,涵盖基于包容性、透明度和问责制的参与式方法。公共卫生、动物健康和环境部门之间,以及与地方政府之间的功能性跨部门合作,对于One Health方法实现切实可行、成本效益高的减少人兽共患病风险和有效响应,同时支持可持续的家庭粮食和营养安全至关重要。

papers.title: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5N1 in Missouri: Current Situation and Pandemic Potential.
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1, which has caused severe disease in poultry since 1996, has become panzootic in wild birds and recently has spread to dairy cattle and other mammalian species in the United States. Although few human cases have been reported, devastating HPAI H5N1 poultry outbreaks and massive dieoffs in wild birds and in some mammals raise concern about pandemic potential. Surveillance, early detection, public health interventions, farm biosecurity measures, and next-generation vaccines may reduce the risk of a future HPAI H5N1 pandemic.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focuses on the current situation of HPAI H5N1 in Missouri, examining its spread to poultry, wild birds, and some mammals.
analysis.methods: The study relies on surveillance data, outbreak reports, and observations of HPAI H5N1 spread in Missouri, including its presence in poultry, wild birds, and some mammals.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the current situation of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 in Missouri, highlighting its spread to poultry, wild birds, and some mammals. The research underscores the growing concern about pandemic potential due to the severity of outbreaks and die-offs. The authors emphasize the importance of surveillance, early detection, and public health interventions to reduce the risk of a future HPAI H5N1 pandemic. However, the study is based on observational data without detailed statistical analysis, which may limit the strength of the evidence. The findings suggest that farm biosecurity measures and next-generation vaccines could play a critical role in preventing the spread of HPAI H5N1 to humans.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 自1996年以来,高致病性禽流感(HPAI)H5N1在禽类中引发了严重疾病,现已在野生鸟类中广泛传播,并最近在美国传播至奶牛和其他哺乳动物物种。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于密苏里州高致病性禽流感H5N1的当前状况,考察其在禽类、野生鸟类和某些哺乳动物中的传播情况。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究依赖于监测数据、疫情报告以及对密苏里州高致病性禽流感H5N1传播的观察,包括其在禽类、野生鸟类和某些哺乳动物中的存在情况。
elements_zh.main_results: 尽管人类病例报告较少,但高致病性禽流感H5N1对禽类的毁灭性影响以及野生鸟类和某些哺乳动物中大规模死亡事件引发了对大流行潜力的担忧。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为由于高致病性禽流感H5N1在多种动物物种中的传播,对大流行潜力的担忧正在增加,强调了需要提高警惕性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了加强监测、早期发现和公共卫生干预措施在降低未来高致病性禽流感H5N1大流行风险中的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于观察性数据,未包含详细的统计分析,这可能限制了关于大流行潜力的证据强度。

papers.title: Dairy producers' perceptions of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 and their influence on implementation of biosecurity changes
papers.abstract: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza(HPAI) H5N1 in dairy cattle has presented a major challengefor dairy producers in the United States, who havehad to make biosecurity decisions with limited informationwhile balancing evolving guidance, existing beliefs,and farm management constraints. This study aimed(1) to describe dairy producers’ perceptions and understandingof HPAI; (2) to characterize experiences andperceived influence among producers affected by HPAI;(3) to identify farm characteristics associated with implementationof biosecurity changes in response to HPAIrisk; and (4) to assess whether perceived biosecurityeffectiveness was associated with implementation of biosecuritychanges and whether concern about HPAI andperceived farm-level risk helped explain this relationship.A questionnaire mailed to Michigan dairy facilitiesyielded a 15.6% response rate (n = 120/766). Descriptivestatistics, modified Poisson regression, logistic regression,and parallel mediation analysis using parametricg-computation were used to evaluate survey responsesand associations with implementation of biosecuritychanges. Overall, 18 respondents (15%) reported confirmedor suspected HPAI on their farms. Most respondentsreported being moderately to very familiar withHPAI (76%) and receiving sufficient guidance about thedisease (83%). The most frequently selected informationsources were veterinary professionals (72%), governmenthealth agencies (52%), and industry associations (48%).Producers most frequently identified wildlife (74%) as alikely route of HPAI introduction, followed by airbornetransmission (34%), cattle movement (23%), and sharingworkers with other operations (12%). Among affectedfarms, the reported clinical phase lasted a median of 21d, whereas reduced productivity lasted a median of 40d. Median self-estimated economic loss was $152 perlactating cow. Among farms without reported confirmedor suspected HPAI, farms with ≥15 employees were morelikely to report implementing biosecurity changes thanfarms with <5 employees (risk ratio [RR] = 2.26; 95%CI: 1.24–4.10), and farms using robotic milking systemswere more likely to report changes than farms using parloror rotary systems (RR = 2.07; 95% CI: 1.21–3.55).From a mediation analysis (n = 93), the estimated probabilityof implementing biosecurity changes was 45.7%among producers who perceived biosecurity as effective,compared with 21.4% among those who did not, correspondingto a 24.3 percentage-point difference (95% CI:5.4–42.4). On the odds-ratio (OR) scale, perceived biosecurityeffectiveness was associated with greater oddsof implementing biosecurity changes (OR = 3.17; 95%CI: 1.21–8.26), greater concern about HPAI (OR = 4.26;95% CI: 1.58–11.51), and greater odds of perceiving thefarm as lower risk than other farms in the state (OR =2.56; 95% CI: 1.05–6.25). The indirect effect throughconcern about HPAI was 9.4 percentage points, accountingfor ~39% of the total association, whereas the indirecteffect through perceived farm-level risk was smalland not clearly different from zero. Overall, these findingssuggest that implementation of biosecurity changesmay be supported by trusted communication strategiesthat emphasize the effectiveness of specific biosecuritypractices and present the disease as a relevant but stillmanageable farm-level threat, and better align producers’perceptions with evidence-supported transmissionpathways, particularly modifiable routes such as animalmovement, personnel movement, and shared equipment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed due to the challenges posed by the emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 in dairy cattle, requiring biosecurity decisions with limited information while balancing evolving guidance, existing beliefs, and farm management constraints.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study aimed to describe dairy producers’ perceptions and understanding of HPAI, characterize experiences and perceived influence among producers affected by HPAI, identify farm characteristics associated with implementation of biosecurity changes in response to HPAI risk, and assess whether perceived biosecurity effectiveness was associated with implementation of biosecurity changes. A questionnaire mailed to Michigan dairy facilities yielded a 15.6% response rate (n = 120/766).
analysis.methods: Descriptive statistics, modified Poisson regression, logistic regression, and parallel mediation analysis using parametric g-computation were used to evaluate survey responses and associations with implementation of biosecurity changes.
analysis.main_results: Overall, 18 respondents (15%) reported confirmed or suspected HPAI on their farms. Among farms without reported confirmed or suspected HPAI, farms with ≥15 employees were more likely to report implementing biosecurity changes than farms with <5 employees (risk ratio [RR] = 2.26; 95% CI: 1.24–4.10), and farms using robotic milking systems were more likely to report changes than farms using parlor or rotary systems (RR = 2.07; 95% CI: 1.21–3.55). From a mediation analysis (n = 93), the estimated probability of implementing biosecurity changes was 45.7% among producers who perceived biosecurity as effective, compared with 21.4% among those who did not, corresponding to a 24.3 percentage-point difference (95% CI: 5.4–42.4).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that implementation of biosecurity changes may be supported by trusted communication strategies that emphasize the effectiveness of specific biosecurity practices and present the disease as a relevant but still manageable farm-level threat.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform the development of targeted communication strategies to improve biosecurity practices among dairy producers, particularly by aligning their perceptions with evidence-supported transmission pathways.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data and the potential for bias in perception-based responses, but the evidence is strong given the use of statistical analyses and the relatively large sample size.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores dairy producers' perceptions of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 and their influence on biosecurity changes. It highlights the challenges producers face in making biosecurity decisions with limited information, balancing guidance, beliefs, and farm constraints. The research aimed to describe perceptions, characterize experiences, identify farm characteristics associated with biosecurity changes, and assess the relationship between perceived biosecurity effectiveness and implementation. A questionnaire was sent to Michigan dairy facilities, achieving a 15.6% response rate. Descriptive statistics and regression analyses were used to evaluate responses. Results showed that 15% of respondents reported confirmed or suspected HPAI on their farms. Among unaffected farms, those with more employees and robotic milking systems were more likely to implement biosecurity changes. The study found that perceived biosecurity effectiveness significantly influenced implementation, with a 24.3 percentage-point difference observed. It also noted that concern about HPAI and perceived farm-level risk played a role in this relationship. The findings suggest that effective communication strategies emphasizing biosecurity practices and presenting HPAI as a manageable threat could support better implementation of biosecurity measures. However, the study's reliance on self-reported data introduces potential bias, limiting the confidence in the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the study design and statistical methods used.

analysis_en.methods: Descriptive statistics, modified Poisson regression, logistic regression, and parallel mediation analysis using parametric g-computation were used to evaluate survey responses and associations with implementation of biosecurity changes.

papers.title_zh: 奶业生产者对高致病性禽流感(高致病性禽流感)H5N1的认知及其对实施生物安全措施的影响
papers.source_body_en: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza(HPAI) H5N1 in dairy cattle has presented a major challengefor dairy producers in the United States, who havehad to make biosecurity decisions with limited informationwhile balancing evolving guidance, existing beliefs,and farm management constraints. This study aimed(1) to describe dairy producers’ perceptions and understandingof HPAI; (2) to characterize experiences andperceived influence among producers affected by HPAI;(3) to identify farm characteristics associated with implementationof biosecurity changes in response to HPAIrisk; and (4) to assess whether perceived biosecurityeffectiveness was associated with implementation of biosecuritychanges and whether concern about HPAI andperceived farm-level risk helped explain this relationship.A questionnaire mailed to Michigan dairy facilitiesyielded a 15.6% response rate (n = 120/766). Descriptivestatistics, modified Poisson regression, logistic regression,and parallel mediation analysis using parametricg-computation were used to evaluate survey responsesand associations with implementation of biosecuritychanges. Overall, 18 respondents (15%) reported confirmedor suspected HPAI on their farms. Most respondentsreported being moderately to very familiar withHPAI (76%) and receiving sufficient guidance about thedisease (83%). The most frequently selected informationsources were veterinary professionals (72%), governmenthealth agencies (52%), and industry associations (48%).Producers most frequently identified wildlife (74%) as alikely route of HPAI introduction, followed by airbornetransmission (34%), cattle movement (23%), and sharingworkers with other operations (12%). Among affectedfarms, the reported clinical phase lasted a median of 21d, whereas reduced productivity lasted a median of 40d. Median self-estimated economic loss was $152 perlactating cow. Among farms without reported confirmedor suspected HPAI, farms with ≥15 employees were morelikely to report implementing biosecurity changes thanfarms with <5 employees (risk ratio [RR] = 2.26; 95%CI: 1.24–4.10), and farms using robotic milking systemswere more likely to report changes than farms using parloror rotary systems (RR = 2.07; 95% CI: 1.21–3.55).From a mediation analysis (n = 93), the estimated probabilityof implementing biosecurity changes was 45.7%among producers who perceived biosecurity as effective,compared with 21.4% among those who did not, correspondingto a 24.3 percentage-point difference (95% CI:5.4–42.4). On the odds-ratio (OR) scale, perceived biosecurityeffectiveness was associated with greater oddsof implementing biosecurity changes (OR = 3.17; 95%CI: 1.21–8.26), greater concern about HPAI (OR = 4.26;95% CI: 1.58–11.51), and greater odds of perceiving thefarm as lower risk than other farms in the state (OR =2.56; 95% CI: 1.05–6.25). The indirect effect throughconcern about HPAI was 9.4 percentage points, accountingfor ~39% of the total association, whereas the indirecteffect through perceived farm-level risk was smalland not clearly different from zero. Overall, these findingssuggest that implementation of biosecurity changesmay be supported by trusted communication strategiesthat emphasize the effectiveness of specific biosecuritypractices and present the disease as a relevant but stillmanageable farm-level threat, and better align producers’perceptions with evidence-supported transmissionpathways, particularly modifiable routes such as animalmovement, personnel movement, and shared equipment.

papers.title: A GIS-based framework for standardized environmental characterization in One-Health surveillance: a case study of highly pathogenic avian influenza monitoring in Italian wetlands
papers.abstract: The Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) panzootic caused by H5 viruses of clade 2.3.4.4b is constantly re-shaping disease ecology in terms of spatio-temporal spread and host spectrum. Because of this, there is an increasing need to complement traditional surveillance methods with approaches that consider environmental factors into epidemiological interpretation. Although environmental surveillance is increasingly recognized within a One Health framework, environmental descriptors are not always consistently structured, underscoring the importance of adopting standardized approaches for their collection and management. A GIS-based framework was developed to standardize environmental characterization of HPAI surveillance sites. Environmental data were collected at nine wetlands in north-eastern Italy, using ESRI field map tool, synchronised through ArcGIS online. Data were validated with field-base ground truthing, stored in a spatial relational database and aggregated into harmonised site-specific descriptors, suitable for epidemiological modelling and analyses. This study introduces a GIS-based framework designed to standardize how environmental features are recorded at sampling sites for HPAI surveillance. The workflow turns different types of field observations into organized geographical datasets that can be analysed. When used at wetland surveillance sites in north-eastern Italy, this framework produced consistent environmental data and standardized records for each site. The workflow combines mobile GIS tools (ESRI Field Maps), ArcGIS Online/Pro, and a PostGIS database to create standardized outputs for epidemiological analysis. This setup creates a reliable connection between field ecology, spatial data infrastructures, and disease risk analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a GIS-based framework designed to standardize environmental characterization for highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) surveillance in Italian wetlands. The HPAI panzootic, driven by H5 viruses of clade 2.3.4.4b, has been reshaping disease ecology by altering spatio-temporal spread and host spectrum. The framework was developed to address the need for integrating environmental factors into epidemiological interpretation, as traditional surveillance methods often lack consistent environmental descriptors. Environmental data were collected at nine wetlands in north-eastern Italy using ESRI field map tools and ArcGIS online, validated with field-based ground truthing, and stored in a spatial relational database. The results showed that the framework produced consistent environmental data and standardized records for each site. The authors interpreted these findings as demonstrating the framework's utility in enhancing disease risk analysis by creating a reliable connection between field ecology and spatial data infrastructures. The study's implications suggest that such standardized approaches can improve surveillance and modeling efforts for avian influenza. However, the study is limited by its geographic focus and lack of direct comparisons with other methods, though the evidence is strong due to the rigorous data collection and validation processes.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情的标准化环境监测方法提供信息,提高流行病学模型的准确性,并支持更有效的疾病风险分析。

papers.abstract_zh: 由2.3.4.4b亚型H5病毒引起的高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情不断重塑疾病生态学的时空传播特征和病原体谱系。因此,有必要将传统方法与考虑环境因素的流行病学解释方法相结合。尽管环境特征在One Health框架中日益受到重视,但环境描述符并不总是结构一致,这凸显了采用标准化方法进行数据收集和管理的重要性。为此,开发了一个基于地理信息系统(GIS)的框架,用于标准化高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情发生地的环境特征描述。在意大利东北部的九个湿地中,使用ESRI Field Maps工具收集了环境数据,并通过ArcGIS在线平台进行同步。数据通过实地验证进行校准,存储在空间关系型数据库中,并汇总为适用于流行病学建模和分析的标准化站点描述符。本研究介绍了一种基于GIS的框架,旨在标准化高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情发生地采样点的环境特征记录方式。该工作流程将不同类型的现场观察转化为有组织的地理数据集,便于分析。当在意大利东北部湿地中应用该框架时,能够产生一致的环境数据和标准化的站点记录。该工作流程结合了移动GIS工具(ESRI Field Maps)、ArcGIS在线/专业版以及PostGIS数据库,以创建适用于流行病学分析的标准化输出。这种设置建立了现场生态学、空间数据基础设施和疾病风险分析之间的可靠联系。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决将环境因素整合到高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情的流行病学解释中的需求,因为由2.3.4.4b亚型H5病毒引起的HPAI疫情不断重塑疾病生态学的时空传播特征和病原体谱系。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 开发了一个基于地理信息系统(GIS)的框架,用于标准化高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情发生地的环境特征描述,具体实施于意大利东北部的九个湿地。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用ESRI Field Maps工具收集环境数据,并通过ArcGIS在线平台进行同步,通过基于现场的实地验证进行校准,存储在空间关系型数据库中,并汇总为适用于流行病学建模和分析的标准化站点描述符。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该框架在意大利东北部的九个湿地中产生了一致的环境数据和标准化的站点记录。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为展示了基于GIS的框架在标准化高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情发生地环境数据收集中的实用性,引入了一种新颖的方法,将现场生态学与空间数据基础设施相结合,用于疾病风险分析。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为高致病性禽流感(HPAI)疫情的标准化环境监测方法提供信息,提高流行病学模型的准确性,并支持更有效的疾病风险分析。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其专注于特定地理区域,并且没有与其他环境监测方法进行直接比较,但由于使用了经过验证的现场数据和标准化的数据管理,其证据是强有力的。}}{

analysis.scope_and_question: This scoping review protocol aims to explore surveillance approaches for bird-to-human avian influenza transmission in England. The focus is on avian influenza A viruses, avian-origin zoonotic infections, and qualified avian subtypes. The central question is to identify and map the existing literature on surveillance methods for avian influenza transmission to humans.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a scoping review protocol, which outlines the methodology for systematically identifying, selecting, and synthesizing relevant literature. The evidence is sourced from the provided protocol, which describes the research project, aims, and expected outcomes. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates, but it outlines the general approach to literature synthesis.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review protocol does not report on substantive conclusions or pooled estimates. It outlines the research objectives and the framework for conducting the scoping review, but no evidence-supported findings are provided.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The supplied evidence does not report on controversies or evidence gaps. It focuses on the methodology and objectives of the scoping review rather than on conflicting findings or unresolved questions.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review protocol does not provide specific research or practice implications. It outlines the scope and methodology but does not suggest actionable priorities for surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, or policy.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review protocol outlines the methodology for investigating surveillance approaches for bird-to-human avian influenza transmission in England. The review focuses on avian influenza A viruses and related zoonotic infections, aiming to map existing literature on surveillance methods. The protocol does not report on substantive conclusions, pooled estimates, or specific implications for research or practice. It serves as a framework for identifying and synthesizing relevant studies, but no evidence-supported findings are provided.

papers.full_text: The cow udder as an influenza mixing ground Bovine mammary tissue can support infection and replication of diverse influenza A viruses and may provide an environment in which different viral strains can co-infect cells. Related research article Pinto RM, Sharp CP, Beeson M, Pankaew N, Hassard JA, Moxom A, Magill C, Ross RA, Tuck L, Meek S, Lee HM, Jensen K, Dry I, Melo P, Yang J, Tan WS, Raut AA, Mishra A, de Wit S, Fitzgerald JR, Hope JC, Joanne Stevens S, Tom Burdon T, Sutton K, Esteves CL, Donadeu FX, Brown I, Barclay W, Peacock TP, Goldhill DH, Iqbal M, Murcia PR, Haslam SM, Gaunt E, Digard P. 2026. The cow udder is a potential coinfection site for influenza A viruses. eLife 15:RP111076. doi: 10.7554/eLife.111076. Avian flu is caused by the influenza A virus and mostly affects birds. But depending on its subtype, the virus can infect a wide range of host species, including mammals. Pigs are considered potential “gene mixing vessels” for multiple viral subtypes, as they can be infected with avian, swine, and human influenza A viruses. Since 2020, the subtype H5N1 (clade 2.3.4.4b) has spread globally, causing mass mortalities in wild birds and poultry, and frequent transmission to several mammalian species, including occasional human infections. In spring 2024, H5N1 was detected in dairy cattle in the United States, where the virus subsequently spread among herds across several states. This sustained circulation has raised questions about whether cattle may also provide opportunities for further viral adaptation and reassortment. To date, two genotypes have been identified in US dairy cattle: B3.13, which was the first to infect dairy cows, and D1.1, which crossed the species barrier more recently in early 2025. Intriguingly, cows do not show respiratory symptoms. Instead, they develop an abrupt drop in milk production, which correlates with high levels of virus in the milk. Human infections with ‘cow flu’ have also been reported, and laboratory studies have shown that bovine-derived isolates can replicate and cause disease in different animal models. However, human-to-human transmission has not yet been reported. Now, in eLife, Rute Maria Pinto, Colin P. Sharp, Eleanor Gaunt, Paul Digard and colleagues report new insights on how the cow udder could serve as a mixing vessel for different strains of influenza A viruses. The researchers, based at various research institutes in the United Kingdom, India and the Netherlands, infected different cow-derived cells with bovine, as well as avian, human and swine virus strains, and analyzed the virus’ ability to replicate and infect various bovine cells (Figure 1). The results showed that mammary cells could easily be infected by many different influenza A viruses. They then compared the fitness of bovine viruses with that of an avian precursor strain. Using several assays to measure viral replication, they found that three of the eight RNA gene segments of an influenza A virus (PB2, PA, and NS) improved the B3.13 virus’s ability to adapt to bovine cells. Properties of different bovine mammary gland culture models. Different approaches have been used to model the bovine mammary gland. These include two cell line models: a continuous cell line (MAC-T), which can be grown and divided repeatedly, and a primary bovine mammary cell line (bMEC) isolated from tissue. Infection of both cell lines supports efficient replication of influenza A viruses across different subtypes and serotypes. Mass spectrometry analysis revealed a complex glycome in both cell lines (top of the figure). When a tissue explant was infected with 2.3.4.4b viruses, viral replication efficiency differed between strains (bottom of the figure). The explant glycome has yet to be characterized. Furthermore, Pinto et al. used reassortant or ‘mixed’ viruses containing two gene segments from one virus and six from another, carrying PR8 glycoproteins HA and NA as their surface proteins (2:6) – molecules that help the virus attach, enter, and leave host cells. This approach revealed that unadapted 2:6 2.3.4.4b strains, including avian Eurasian strains, could also replicate to high levels in cow mammary cells. These findings are consistent with other studies reporting the susceptibility of various bovine cell culture systems to different influenza viruses, including replication in bovine skin fibroblasts and mammary gland organoids (e.g.,). Working with H5N1-infected, lactating cattle in high containment presents obvious infrastructural and logistical challenges. Thus, developing alternative bovine models that maintain biological relevance while reducing operational complexity is warranted. However, many models may lose some bovine characteristics in culture. When Pinto et al. infected mammary explants – the closest culture system to the actual udder – they found marked differences in viral quantities between bovine and precursor H5N1 strains. Thus, a bovine-adapted phenotype is relevant for achieving high viral loads in the cow udder. Noticeably, the viruses used in the infection experiments were 2:6 viruses again. The circulating bovine viruses have unique receptor-binding properties and are more promiscuous than classical H5 viruses before the introduction of the 2.3.4.4 antigenic clade. It is, thus, unclear whether the different authentic H5N1 viruses would similarly infect these relevant cultures. To further investigate the cow udder’s potential as a mixing vessel, the presence of both avian-type and human-type sialic acid receptors, which can serve as attachment points for influenza viruses, was examined using mass spectrometry. They found both receptor types, concluding that their infection experiments provide evidence that bovine cells can support infection with many different influenza A viruses. However, it would be useful to analyze the complete collection of sugars present on the cells and tissues of the explants and determine whether differences exist between cow tissues. Importantly, current mass spectrometry analyses have a clear caveat: they only represent possible glycan structures inferred from their measured masses rather than definitive structural assignments. Finally, a co-infection experiment in bovine cells using a human and an avian influenza strain produced a cell population infected with both viruses, providing an important proof of principle for co-infection and reassortment. Taken together, the study by Pinto et al. supports the hypothesis that co-infections of human and avian viruses within the cow mammary glands are possible and thus reassortment events in the cow udder cannot be ruled out. Properties of different bovine mammary gland culture models. Different approaches have been used to model the bovine mammary gland. These include two cell line models: a continuous cell line (MAC-T), which can be grown and divided repeatedly, and a primary bovine mammary cell line (bMEC) isolated from tissue. Infection of both cell lines supports efficient replication of influenza A viruses across different subtypes and serotypes. Mass spectrometry analysis revealed a complex glycome in both cell lines (top of the figure). When a tissue explant was infected with 2.3.4.4b viruses, viral replication efficiency differed between strains (bottom of the figure). The explant glycome has yet to be characterized. Furthermore, Pinto et al. used reassortant or ‘mixed’ viruses containing two gene segments from one virus and six from another, carrying PR8 glycoproteins HA and NA as their surface proteins (2:6) – molecules that help the virus attach, enter, and leave host cells. This approach revealed that unadapted 2:6 2.3.4.4b strains, including avian Eurasian strains, could also replicate to high levels in cow mammary cells. These findings are consistent with other studies reporting the susceptibility of various bovine cell culture systems to different influenza viruses, including replication in bovine skin fibroblasts and mammary gland organoids (e.g.,). Working with H5N1-infected, lactating cattle in high containment presents obvious infrastructural and logistical challenges. Thus, developing alternative bovine models that maintain biological relevance while reducing operational complexity is warranted. However, many models may lose some bovine characteristics in culture. When Pinto et al. infected mammary explants – the closest culture system to the actual udder – they found marked differences in viral quantities between bovine and precursor H5N1 strains. Thus, a bovine-adapted phenotype is relevant for achieving high viral loads in the cow udder. Noticeably, the viruses used in the infection experiments were 2:6 viruses again. The circulating bovine viruses have unique receptor-binding properties and are more promiscuous than classical H5 viruses before the introduction of the 2.3.4.4 antigenic clade. It is, thus, unclear whether the different authentic H5N1 viruses would similarly infect these relevant cultures. To further investigate the cow udder’s potential as a mixing vessel, the presence of both avian-type and human-type sialic acid receptors, which can serve as attachment points for influenza viruses, was examined using mass spectrometry. They found both receptor types, concluding that their infection experiments provide evidence that bovine cells can support infection with many different influenza A viruses. However, it would be useful to analyze the complete collection of sugars present on the cells and tissues of the explants and determine whether differences exist between cow tissues. Importantly, current mass spectrometry analyses have a clear caveat: they only represent possible glycan structures inferred from their measured masses rather than definitive structural assignments. Finally, a co-infection experiment in bovine cells using a human and an avian influenza strain produced a cell population infected with both viruses, providing an important proof of principle for co-infection and reassortment. Taken together, the study by Pinto et al. supports the hypothesis that co-infections of human and avian viruses within the cow mammary glands are possible and thus reassortment events in the cow udder cannot be ruled out. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether the cow udder could serve as a mixing ground for influenza A viruses, particularly in light of the global spread of H5N1 and its ability to infect mammals. This is important because the sustained circulation of H5N1 in dairy cattle raises concerns about its potential for further adaptation and reassortment.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using bovine-derived cell lines and tissue explants, with a focus on H5N1-infected dairy cattle in the United States. The researchers infected different cow-derived cells with various influenza A virus strains, including avian, human, and swine viruses, to analyze their replication and infection capabilities.
analysis.methods: The researchers used several assays to measure viral replication and compared the fitness of bovine viruses with an avian precursor strain. They also performed co-infection experiments in bovine cells using human and avian influenza strains to assess the potential for co-infection and reassortment.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that mammary cells could be infected by many different influenza A viruses. Additionally, co-infection experiments in bovine cells using human and avian influenza strains produced a cell population infected with both viruses, providing proof of principle for co-infection and reassortment.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings support the hypothesis that co-infections of human and avian viruses within the cow mammary glands are possible, thus reassortment events in the cow udder cannot be ruled out.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the potential role of the cow udder in facilitating viral adaptation and reassortment, which has implications for surveillance and understanding the evolution of influenza A viruses, particularly H5N1, in mammalian hosts.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates whether the cow udder can serve as a mixing ground for influenza A viruses, particularly H5N1, which has been detected in dairy cattle in the United States. The researchers infected bovine-derived cells with various influenza strains, including avian, human, and swine viruses, and found that mammary cells could be easily infected by many different influenza A viruses. Co-infection experiments demonstrated the potential for co-infection and reassortment, supporting the hypothesis that the cow udder may facilitate viral adaptation. The study highlights the importance of understanding this potential role for surveillance and public health, but it has limitations, such as the use of cell lines that may not fully represent bovine tissue characteristics and the reliance on inferred glycan structures from mass spectrometry. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on laboratory experiments rather than direct field observations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨奶牛乳房是否可以作为甲型流感病毒的混合场所,特别是在H5N1全球传播及其能够感染哺乳动物的背景下。这一点很重要,因为H5N1在奶牛中的持续传播引发了其进一步适应和重组的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了源自牛的细胞系和组织切片,重点关注美国H5N1感染奶牛的情况。研究人员将不同来源的牛细胞感染多种甲型流感病毒株,包括禽类、人类和猪类病毒,以分析其复制和感染能力。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用了多种实验来测量病毒复制,并比较了牛病毒与禽类前体株的适应性。他们还使用人类和 禽流感 株在牛细胞中进行了共感染实验,以评估共感染和重组的潜力。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,乳腺细胞可以被多种不同的甲型流感病毒感染。此外,在牛细胞中使用人类和 禽流感 株进行共感染实验产生了同时感染两种病毒的细胞群体,为共感染和重组提供了原理性证据。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现支持了人类和禽类病毒在牛乳腺中共感染的可能性,因此不能排除牛乳房中发生重组事件的可能。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究突显了奶牛乳房在促进病毒适应和重组中的潜在作用,这对 监测 和理解甲型流感病毒,特别是H5N1,在哺乳动物 宿主 中的 进化 具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究存在局限性,包括使用可能在培养过程中失去部分牛特性的细胞系,以及当前的质谱分析只能推断可能的糖基结构,而不能明确确定它们。尽管存在这些局限性,但证据是中等的。

papers.title: Probiotics as a Strategy for Mitigating Viral Infections in Poultry: Immunomodulatory Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential.
papers.abstract: Poultry viral infections remain a persistent challenge for the poultry industry, causing significant economic losses and posing potential threats to human health. The escalating frequency of outbreaks involving pathogens, such as infectious bronchitis virus (IBV), Newcastle disease virus (NDV) and avian influenza virus (AIV), underscores the urgent need for effective interventions. Probiotics have gained attention as a promising strategy to combat these viral infections due to their potential in enhancing immune responses and establishing a healthy gut microbiome. A literature search was carried out on Google Scholar, Scopus and PubMed using key search terms, such as 'probiotics', 'Lactobacillus', 'acidophilus', 'poultry', 'viral infections', 'Newcastle Disease Virus (NDV)' and other relevant terms. Inclusion criteria for manuscripts used were based on the relevance to probiotic-based interventions in poultry, the focus on immunological mechanisms and the examination of viral pathogens commonly found in West African poultry farming systems. This review explores the role of probiotics in mitigating the effects of NDV, AIV and IBV in poultry, focusing on their immunomodulatory effects and antiviral mechanisms. Lactobacillus acidophilus, L. plantarum have shown an interesting promise in countering NDV infections by modulating immunological parameters and enhancing antibody responses. Similarly, these probiotics have exhibited antiviral activity against AIV, promoting immune activation and reducing viral loads. plantarum have emerged as potential adjuvants for IBV vaccines, improving antibody responses and humoural immunity.
